```{r}
pacman::p_load(
    Ipaper, data.table, dplyr, lubridate
)
devtools::load_all("../..")
```

```{r}
f_met = "data/盘锦-稻田站_Met_30min_2018-2020.csv"
f_flux <- gsub("Met", "Flux", f_met)
```

```{r}
met <- read_ufile(f_met)
met$data %<>% mutate(date = date + dhours(hour(time)) + dminutes(minute(time))) %>%
  select(-time)
met$unit %<>% select(-time)

flux <- read_ufile(f_flux)
flux$data %<>% mutate(date = ymd_hm(paste0(date, " ", time))) %>% select(-time)
flux$unit %<>% select(-time)

write_ufile(met, basename(f_met))
write_ufile(flux, basename(f_flux))
```
